ta_read.text: QQQ's daily swings show lower highs and lower lows; the last structure break was down on Oct 30, when it closed below $701.16. On weekly bars it is in a downtrend (below its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show mixed swings (a range).

The nearest support zone is $659.73–$663.81, where price turned 2 times, most recently on Jul 29, a former resistance that flipped to support; the nearest resistance zone is $684.90–$693.76, where price turned 3 times, most recently on Jul 17.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 9 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 4 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-1.2%) came on light volume.
RSI is 43 (neutral); MACD is below its signal line since Oct 13.
A daily close above $693.76 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $659.73 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
